recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14394 unless a work group files a new issue for event statements still outside the expressivity of EventDefinition and TriggerDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-14394 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification decision for STU3. It asked to change TriggerDefinition.dataRequirement, now TriggerDefinition.data, to 0..* and explain multiple data requirements as AND; change EventDefinition.triggerDefinition, now EventDefinition.trigger, to 1..* and explain multiple triggers as OR; and add a request for comment about statements not currently possible.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 478a62a85ba492b64db444f330043aed7d432843, 'GF#14394 - event definition cardinality adjustments', which changed source/datatypes/triggerdefinition.xml and source/eventdefinition/eventdefinition-spreadsheet.xml. Later refactors moved the EventDefinition element into source/eventdefinition/structuredefinition-EventDefinition.xml while retaining the requested cardinality and OR semantics.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini confirms TriggerDefinition and EventDefinition are active current-build artifacts. Later decisions FHIR-21232, FHIR-53316, and FHIR-53414 changed SubscriptionTopic support, EventDefinition deprecation status, examples, and condition guidance without reversing the FHIR-14394 AND/OR model. Clean community searches found no conflicting Confluence or substantive Zulip evidence. The old request-for-comment item appears ballot-era and is not a current R6 source correction.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. TriggerDefinition.data is currently 0..* DataRequirement and says multiple data requirements are ANDed/all must be true; EventDefinition.trigger is currently 1..* and says multiple triggers are ORed/any matching trigger condition fires the event.
